mission: Coverage gap check D9 (owner request 2026-10-16), Step 1: add two reviewed read-only db-diagnostic SQL files that classify every active verified print without a fresh Yuyu-Tei price (never discovered, discovered but identity unresolved or mapping not approved, mapped but not refreshed, every same-release listing mapped to a sibling) by rarity and base vs parallel, with the survey sample prints, and register them in ops-readonly. Their rows reach the ops-summary through the existing PR #157 inline budget. Staging only; no collector, setting, mapping, enqueue, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Two SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (7 statements) over card_prints, canonical_cards, release_products, source_card_mappings, freshness_work, freshness_price_states, yuyutei_candidates, yuyutei_discovery_runs and source_mapping_proposal groups/alternatives, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session. No write, no source request.
Adds yuyu-coverage-gap and yuyu-coverage-gap-samples to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (two new read-only SQL files)

impact.deployment_impact: Two read-only diagnostics and their workflow choice entries. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the two diagnostics and their workflow choices. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of either new file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
